recording.notesPlaceholder: Type anything you want to capture: decisions, questions, follow-ups. Steno handles the transcript.
transcript.selectedLanguageHint: The engine may report the selected language rather than detect it independently.
transcript.unknownLanguageHint: The transcription engine did not report a detected language. Notes language can be inferred from the transcript.
transcript.retryLanguageHint: To try another language, choose Re-transcribe recording in the meeting menu. The original audio is required; this replaces the transcript and regenerates the notes.
settings.ai.localParakeetHint: Recommended local option · audio stays on this device
settings.ai.cloudAsr.disclosure: Speech-to-text is sent to an OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint. Unlike the on-device engines, your audio leaves your computer.
settings.ai.cloudAsr.engineTagline: Cloud API - sends audio to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
settings.ai.cloudAsr.confirmTitle: Send audio to a cloud service?
settings.ai.cloudAsr.confirmDescription: Cloud transcription uploads your recording audio to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint you configure. Unlike the on-device engines, your audio leaves your computer. Continue?
settings.ai.cloudAsr.saveSettingError: Could not save this cloud transcription setting. The previous value is still active.
settings.ai.cloudAsr.saveKeyError: Could not securely save the API key. The existing key was not changed.
settings.ai.cloudAsr.keySavedDescription: A key is saved. Enter a new one to replace it, or clear it.
settings.ai.cloudAsr.keyEmptyDescription: Stored encrypted on your device - never written to config or sent anywhere except your chosen endpoint.
settings.ai.cloudAsr.modelHint: Recommended cloud model: gpt-transcribe. Local speaker recognition identifies voices; timestamps mark audio turns rather than individual words.
settings.ai.diarization.label: Speaker detection
settings.ai.diarization.saveError: Could not switch the speaker detection model. The previous model is still active.
settings.ai.diarization.loadError: Could not load the speaker detection setting. Try again.
chat.context.label: Context: {{context}}
chat.context.heading: Attach meeting context
chat.context.hint: Choose notes to reference. You can ask general questions with any context.
chat.error: Unable to answer. Please try again.
chat.saveError: Could not save this chat update. Keep this window open and try again.
downloads.speakers.preparing: Optimising speaker models for this Mac. This can take a minute or two…
setup.speakers.optInDescription: Labels each voice on a call as Speaker 2, Speaker 3 and so on. Downloads about 250 MB. You can also download it later in Settings → AI.
settings.ai.speakers.label: Individual speakers
settings.ai.speakers.description: Splits several voices on the same side of a call into Speaker 2, Speaker 3 and so on. Runs on your device. Downloads about 250 MB.
settings.ai.speakers.failed: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
keychainWaitBanner.waiting_for_keychain_: Waiting for Keychain. Unlock it to load saved API keys and sign-ins.
meetingCalendarSection.no_invitations_fo: No invitations found around this recording.
recordingRecovery.audio_was_kept_recover: These recordings never became notes. Recover processes them with your current transcription settings. Dismiss hides them; the audio stays on disk.
calendar.apple_calendar_is_on_but_stenoa: Apple Calendar is on, but StenoAI doesn't have calendar access.
meetingDetail.this_re_runs_transcription: This re-runs transcription with your transcription settings and the language below, replacing the transcript and regenerating the summary.
people.people_you_ve_named_in_a_meeting: People you've named in a meeting's Speakers section. Steno uses their voice profiles to suggest them in later meetings.
setup.keep_audio_for_listening_language_: Keep audio for listening, language retries and speaker review. When off, audio is deleted after successful transcription. Unfinished audio is kept for recovery.
aiTab.when_saved_audio_passes_this_size_: When saved audio passes this size, the oldest completed recordings are deleted. Unfinished recordings stay protected and can exceed this limit. Notes and transcripts are kept. Now using {{used}}.
aiTab.requests_sent_at_the_same_time_sha: Requests sent at the same time, shared by both channels. Higher is faster until the provider rate-limits.
generalTab.connected_uses_every_calendar: Connected. Uses every calendar in Calendar.app, with attendees; takes precedence over Google/Outlook.
generalTab.use_the_calendars_in_calendar: Use the calendars in Calendar.app (iCloud, Exchange, Google accounts added to your Mac).
integrationsTab.export_full_transcripts_: Export full transcripts and notes, with confirmed and unconfirmed speaker names and calendar invitees. Later edits sync automatically while the app is open. Your vault annotations are preserved.
integrationsTab.transcripts_and_meeting_: Transcripts and meeting notes are written under StenoAI in this vault. Existing standalone layouts are retained.
integrationsTab.choose_the_root_folder_o: Choose the root folder of your Obsidian vault.
integrationsTab.sync_is_on_but_no_vault_: Sync is on but no vault folder is set yet — choose one above to start mirroring.
integrationsTab.existing_vault_content_h: — existing vault content has been kept. Check the vault is available and retry.
integrationsTab.sync_checked_per_note_st: Sync checked. Per-note status shows any pending exports.
calendar.no_meetings: No meetings in the next {{days}} days.
privacy.optionalAnalytics: Anonymous usage analytics is off by default. If enabled, it sends crash and usage signals to StenoLabs via PostHog, excluding meeting content. Launch on login is a separate setting. You can change either preference anytime in Settings.
watchedFolders.heading: Recording folders
watchedFolders.description: Watch folders that another app fills with recordings, such as a phone voice recorder synced with Syncthing. New files appear in All notes, where you choose which ones to transcribe.
watchedFolders.autoHint: Each new recording is transcribed as soon as it has finished syncing. Files already in the folder wait in All notes until you transcribe them.
watchedFolders.unavailable: Folder not found. It may be on a disconnected drive.
watchedFolders.recordingBlocked: Available when the current recording ends.
watchedFolders.previewFailed: This recording could not be played
watchedFolders.unavailableNamed: Recording folder {{folder}} was not found. It may be on a disconnected drive.
watchedFolders.beforeAuto: Arrived before auto-transcribe was turned on for this folder
switchRecording.title: Switch to the next meeting?
switchRecording.description: The current recording will stop and its note will finish in the background. A new recording starts right away.
switchRecording.descriptionNext: The current recording will stop and its note will finish in the background. Recording starts for “{{next}}” right away.
switchRecording.descriptionNamed: “{{current}}” will stop recording and its note will finish in the background. Recording starts for “{{next}}” right away.
switchRecording.failed: Could not stop the current recording
